announcements.title: Masukan Anda untuk NIMA
announcements.body: Kami ingin mendengar pengalaman Anda memakai NIMA. Laporkan BUG ataupun permintaan Penambahan Fitur atau apapun itu melalui tautan di bawah, jawaban Anda membantu kami menentukan prioritas perbaikan.
announcements.bodyEn: We'd love to hear about your experiences using NIMA. Report bugs, feature requests, or anything else you can think of using the link below. Your feedback helps us prioritize improvements.
